cases.name: Jamila Elysse Moss
cases.about:
Her Go Fund Me said, "You were a true light when we had our down times. You showed up for EVERYTHING and never turned down 1 invitation and never failed to capture those moments. You left us with MORE than enough videos and pictures as it was arguably one of your favorite things to do - capture memories. You captured the memories we now get to relive through your social media (those who know, know). You answered our calls while you were hurting to make sure we didn't feel the same hurt.

The way you turned your life around will still be a great testimony unto the Lord. We were all so immensely proud of you. Your single dimple caved the most when someone cracked a good joke. There is one less voice to bounce from wall to wall at our gatherings now.

We love you, we’ll miss you: daughter, granddaughter, sister, niece, aunt, cousin, and friend Jamila ❤️"
